targets.rationale: Incremental sync is CIP's self-updating heart: content-hash vs mtime dirty detection, tier-aware chunking, batched writes + edge rebuild, Windows spawn-safe parallel parse. A missed dirty or orphan row silently lies to every downstream surface (search, audit, gapfill). Highest blast radius.

SQLite WAL + vector cache (vector_signature / _VEC_CACHE) + FTS5 + sqlite-vec/lancedb backends. Cache invalidation, bulk helpers, snapshot durability, and cross-process correctness directly gate search recall and freshness.

Hybrid FTS ⊕ vectors → RRF → rerank + budgeted context pack. Invariants: every returned chunk exists in chunks table, model-mismatch returns lexical-only fallback, RRF never invents IDs, token budget is honoured. Mirrors H5 paired-read divergence (index vs retrieve).

Embedding resolution order: daemon warm RemoteEmbedder vs LocalEmbedder singleton, autostart flag, service_port resolution (embed.service_port → serve.port → 8787, daemon.port drift), dimension mismatch, batch truncation. A wrong fallback silently kills semantic search.

Audit rule engine: 20+ rules (secrets, DB-N1, hidden exports, Next.js leak, QA-*, ARCH-*). Precision is critical: rules must NOT flag NONPROD, test, .d.ts, dynamic_entry_roots. Stable IDs + auto-close only for enabled rules (BUG-015). False positives destroy trust.

Import graph correctness: Python relative dots (.base → ..stack.audit), TS alias via tsconfig baseUrl/paths, Node16 ESM .js→.ts extension stripping, per-directory resolver for monorepos. A wrong edge poisons impact analysis, tested_by, circular detection.

Gapfill signals (coverage, dead, circular, blame, env, logs, metrics, deps, api) + analysis.repo_health_report + health scoring (freshness, vector coverage, dead ratio, critical findings) + snapshots. Missing evidence must not default to healthy (H14).

File watcher + WriteLock + daemon interval + sync job snapshots. Coalescence, lock contention, event_days vacuum vs snapshots exemption, and re-entrance (sync while syncing) are classic race/idempotency hazards (H12).

Temporal KG + episodic + procedural memory + consolidation daemon. Invariants: consolidation is idempotent, time-bounded queries respect valid_from/valid_until, episodes never leak PII, 120K checkpoint survives autocompact.
